_doc: custodyReveal (STEP 2/2). Page TERPISAH yang dituju P6. Baca opening doc (ip[] yg ditulis P6 + ie[] gudang), REVEAL angka gudang, COMPARE per item, lalu BRANCH: match→P7, selisih→P8. matchRoute/mismatchRoute ADA DI SINI (CUSTODY_REVEAL), bukan di count-list. Data dari P6 nyebrang lewat FIRESTORE (ip[] di opening doc), bukan passParams.
_write: dp[] = ARRAY → NATIVE (dev) doc.update({dp:[...]}). rs = scalar → DSL boleh / native. cst = di P7/P8 (bukan di sini). Tombol match → write rs=matched (native/DSL) → nav P7. Tombol selisih → compute dp[] (ip vs ie: ex=ie.qt, ac=ip.qt, dl=ac-ex) + write dp[]+rs=discrepancy_detected (native) → nav P8.
_types: type UPPERCASE_SNAKE. CUSTODY_REVEAL = widget BARU (read-only compare + computed branch).
